title: Consume canonical models/meanings for explained public suggestions
resolution:
Phase 4 prerequisite: canonical registry-driven semantic ingestion/explained suggestions and existing HTTPS catalog contract integration. Independent call-site search finds no shipped catalog UI ingestion; passing contract/source read is not a UI journey.

Phase3 root-acceptance binding: OPEN blocking phases4/5/6 completion. F1 requires registry-derived ingestion, explained suggestions and HTTPS catalog integration; canonical registry mutation must change suggestions after documented cache invalidation. No automatic user-data query/upload for metadata discovery. Closure requires exact-source product evidence, not a static catalog or contract-only probe.
